shortBio.en: Strokes vocalist; clipped NYC delivery on Is This It–era singles.
shortBio.zh: The Strokes 主唱；《Is This It》时期纽约式短促咬字。

body.en: Born 1978, New York. Lead vocals and much of the lyric on early Strokes records. Later solo and The Voidz projects.
body.zh: 1978 年生于纽约。早期 Strokes 唱片主唱与大量歌词。后有个人与 The Voidz 项目。
